run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if change can be given to every person in the queue
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks five and ten bill counts for change
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns 1 or 0 based on whether all change can be given
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a dictionary instead of separate fiveCount and tenCount variables
